lineage.rule: Inherited IDs and URLs are preserved; reviser observations use distinct IDs and do not silently rebind prior evidence.

sources.title: Media Fragments URI 1.0 (basic)
sources.locator: §4.2.1 Temporal Dimension, lines 221–240; §6.1.1 Valid temporal dimension
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Recommendation and read the temporal range syntax and semantics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: t= encodes an interval; omitted begin defaults to 0 and omitted end to duration; intervals are half-open [begin,end); NPT uses seconds/fraction; hh:mm:ss is convenience and does not signal frame accuracy.
sources.applicability: Useful for exported time-fragment notation and interval boundary convention only. Does not identify a local file revision or promise decoder seek accuracy.

sources.title: Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: Fragment Selector §4.2.2; Text Position Selector §4.2.10 (lines 980–1010); Target/Specific Resource and State sections
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official W3C Recommendation; inspected FragmentSelector and TextPositionSelector definitions and the stale-anchor warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Text positions are zero-based start-inclusive/end-exclusive. The model says they are brittle after edits and recommends a State to identify the correct representation; selectors describe target segments but do not create time synchronization.
sources.applicability: Can inform an optional interoperable annotation envelope and transcript text anchors. Must be extended with local asset revision identity and must not be treated as invented transcript timing.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.locator: SC 1.3.1/1.3.2/1.3.3; 1.4.1 Use of Color; 2.1.1 Keyboard; 2.4.3 Focus Order; 2.4.7 Focus Visible
sources.observed_operation: Opened the Recommendation and inspected the normative keyboard, sensory-characteristics, and color criteria.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: WCAG 2.2 is normative; keyboard operation applies to functionality unless the underlying function depends on path-of-movement rather than endpoints; color cannot be the only visual means.
sources.applicability: Reference requirements for a keyboard/screen-reader interface and non-color overlap identity; desktop applicability depends on the target shell/platform and should be evaluated with its accessibility API.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide: Slider Pattern
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current APG pattern page, unversioned; accessed 2026-10-12
sources.observed_operation: Opened the W3C APG slider pattern and reviewed its keyboard mapping, media seek example, and touch-assistive-technology warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: APG is informative, not a normative WCAG standard. Standard slider keys adjust one step; Home/End select endpoints; Page Up/Down are optional. The guide warns some touch AT may not synthesize the expected key events and requires testing.
sources.applicability: Supports an optional labeled seek slider with named-value output and a separate direct time-field/button route; it does not justify making a slider the only review route.

sources.title: Peaks.js API Documentation
sources.locator: Configuration keyboard options lines 573–581; Segments API § and player API; repo release list also shows v4.0.0-beta.2 as prerelease
sources.observed_operation: Read documentation at the pinned tag and release list; identified seconds-based start/end, stable segment IDs/update operations, keyboard option, nudge increment, and waveform-data options.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: keyboard defaults false; nudgeIncrement defaults 0.01 seconds; segment editable defaults false; labels and rendering options are configurable. A v4 beta exists but is not the stable API baseline.
sources.applicability: Visual detail/overview and segment API candidate. Component keyboard support must be assessed separately from host list editing, focus semantics, and screen-reader completeness.

sources.title: Peaks.js v3.4.2 demo caller
sources.locator: renderSegments and numeric start/end input handlers; Peaks.init options around keyboard:true and precomputed dataUri
sources.observed_operation: Inspected the tagged repository demo source as a caller of the public API.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The demo renders segment rows with label and numeric start/end inputs and calls segment.update; keyboard:true is opted into; precomputed waveform data URIs are shown. The demo is not an accessibility conformance claim.
sources.applicability: Concrete interaction pattern for list + numeric fields + waveform, and a local/precomputed waveform architecture. Use as evidence of a caller pattern only.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js Regions plugin source
sources.locator: RegionParams lines 2326–2376; pointer event stream near 2921–2941; public API lines 3605–3620
sources.observed_operation: Read pinned plugin source and searched for pointer/drag and keyboard event handling.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Region IDs may be passed; start/end are seconds; end omitted defaults to start; drag/resize default true; min/max length are seconds. The inspected source binds pointer events and drag streams; no keydown match appeared in this file.
sources.applicability: Visual interval API candidate; host must provide accessible structured controls and persistent IDs. Absence of a keydown match in this file is limited evidence, not a claim about every host integration.

sources.title: WaveSurfer.js release history
sources.released_version_or_commit: 8.0.0 stable, release commit a1cdffd; 7.x maintenance releases remain listed
sources.locator: 8.0.0 release section and notable fixes: issues #4353, #4348, #4359, #3631/#3658/#3781/#3866; tests/Cypress line in release notes
sources.observed_operation: Read current upstream release page and compared the 8.0.0 notes with issue references.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release history reports fixes for seeks made before metadata, wrong timeupdate after pause in WebAudio, region event race, false region-out at a region start, and related event duplication; release also notes a Cypress test for play/pause/finish event count.
sources.applicability: These are regression scenarios for a candidate integration, not evidence that the proposed app was tested. The release page does not claim accessibility or annotation-fidelity coverage.

sources.title: Audacity Manual: Label Tracks
sources.released_version_or_commit: Rolling online manual; page does not identify a release tag
sources.locator: Point/region labels; Navigating Labels; Label Editor; label file export; limitations
sources.observed_operation: Read the official Audacity manual page and inspected keyboard navigation, table editor, export, and stated limits.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Tab/Shift+Tab cycles labels; Label Editor is described as keyboard-accessible and tabular. Text labels over 260 characters may not reload; hundreds/thousands can slow the app; Export Multiple uses labels from the uppermost label track.
sources.applicability: Interaction/export reference, not an embeddable component recommendation. Confirm any multi-track overlap and merge/export behavior in a product-specific prototype.

sources.title: GStreamer Seeking design documentation
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current unversioned GStreamer design documentation; runtime version not selected
sources.observed_operation: Read the official seeking design page for flag behavior and tradeoffs.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without ACCURATE, demuxer/parser may approximate depending on implementation/index; ACCURATE requires exact positioning relative to stream origin and can require processing from the start; KEY_UNIT changes where the segment begins.
sources.applicability: Shows a local playback backend can expose different fast versus accurate seek modes. Adapter must report capabilities/actual position and benchmark selected formats.

sources.title: AVPlayer precise seek method
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Apple AVFoundation documentation; SDK/runtime version not pinned
sources.observed_operation: Read Apple API documentation for seek completion and tolerance behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The landing may differ within the supplied tolerance. Zero tolerances request sample-accurate seek but may add decode delay; completion can return false when interrupted by a subsequent seek.
sources.applicability: An alternative engine contract example; favors explicit accuracy and completion state. Only applicable if target platforms and Apple runtime are selected.

sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1
sources.released_version_or_commit: Web Audio API 1.1 current editor's draft; accessed 2026-10-12
sources.observed_operation: Read the W3C Web Audio specification's decodeAudioData algorithm.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: decodeAudioData consumes an ArrayBuffer of encoded data and returns decoded PCM AudioBuffer; decoded data is resampled to BaseAudioContext sample rate if needed.
sources.applicability: Relevant if using a browser/WebAudio backend or client-side waveform generation; motivates memory/performance profiling for long stereo files and must not be treated as a guarantee that every codec is supported.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Landing may vary within supplied tolerance; zero tolerances request sample-accurate seek and may add decoding delay.
sources.applicability: Backend example only if AVFoundation is selected.

sources.title: Apple AVPlayer seek completion handler
sources.observed_operation: Read official Apple search result and linked page.

sources.applicability: Supports adapter completion state only if AVPlayer is selected.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 4.1.3 Status Messages
sources.locator: SC 4.1.3 Status Messages, lines 1451–1458; markup-language applicability
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official Recommendation at the status-messages section and read the criterion text.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: For content implemented using markup languages, status messages can be programmatically determined through role/properties for assistive technology without receiving focus.
sources.applicability: Applies to a markup-based view; it does not define announcements for an unspecified native toolkit.

sources.title: GStreamer Seeking design documentation — reviser check
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current unversioned GStreamer design documentation; runtime not selected
sources.observed_operation: Reopened the official design page and checked seek flags, segment-start behavior, approximation, and processing cost.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: KEY_UNIT can move segment start to a nearby key unit; ACCURATE requests accuracy relative to stream beginning and may require processing from the beginning. Behavior is described for elements such as parser/demuxer.
sources.applicability: Shows backend-specific seek behavior and work; does not define this product’s canonical stored-time conversion.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Landing can vary within the supplied tolerance window; zero tolerances request sample-accurate seeking and may add decoding delay.
sources.applicability: Backend example only if AVFoundation is chosen; does not establish a cross-format contract.

sources.title: Apple AVPlayer seek completion handler — reviser check
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current AVFoundation documentation; SDK/runtime not selected
sources.locator: Completion handler behavior for interrupted/in-progress seek
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Apple Developer documentation and read the completion-handler result for interrupted seeks.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: An in-progress seek interrupted by another seek completes with finished=false; successful completion reports true.
sources.applicability: Adapter example for explicit completion state only if AVFoundation is selected.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide: Slider Pattern — reviser check
sources.observed_operation: Opened official WAI APG pattern and checked slider keyboard guidance and touch assistive technology warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: APG is informative; its warning says some touch assistive technologies may not synthesize the keyboard events expected by sliders.
sources.applicability: Optional slider guidance; retain direct buttons/time fields and test on supported assistive technologies.

sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1 — decodeAudioData reviser check
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Web Audio API 1.1 editor’s draft; accessed 2026-10-12
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Web Audio API text at decodeAudioData and inspected the input/decode algorithm.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: decodeAudioData accepts encoded audio data and yields decoded PCM AudioBuffer; decoded audio is resampled to the BaseAudioContext sample rate.
sources.applicability: Relevant if using Web Audio; profile full-buffer memory and do not infer universal format support.
